gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-andika: Strong, open shapes with no calligraphic shading. Bellota Text leads with its commanding look, while Andika, a plain sans whose tails match its stems, carries paragraph after paragraph without a snag.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-bpmf-huninn: Bpmf Huninn is a sans-serif with a single-weight outline feel and a wide channel into every bowl. But Bellota Text, commanding and distinctive, gives it a louder voice with open shapes and no calligraphic shading.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-didact-gothic: Distinctive and open, Bellota Text skips calligraphic shading, earning its keep big and short. And Didact Gothic, a sans with strokes of matching weight, never snags on a closed-up bowl.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-dotgothic16: DotGothic16 is a plain sans with wide channels into every counter. Its tube-like thickness holds through every bend, and Bellota Text, commanding and distinctive, earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-doto: Bellota Text has a commanding, distinctive voice, with open shapes and no calligraphic shading. Doto, a plain sans, offers the quieter strength: wide margins around each glyph and generous mouths on round letters.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-electrolize: Sharp, steady lines: Bellota Text is commanding, with straight-edged, constant strokes. And Electrolize, a sans with an open-jawed c like a pair of pliers, keeps paragraphs moving with a modern, contemporary feel.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-elms-sans: A ballpoint's pressure-free line, with a see-through gap in each s. Elms Sans sits quietly beside the commanding, distinctive Bellota Text, so the two feel modern and at ease.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-encode-sans: Encode Sans is a sans-serif with gaps that stop c from collapsing into o. And beneath Bellota Text, with its commanding, shading-free shapes, paragraphs would read cleanly and without fuss.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-encode-sans-sc: Bellota Text ends every stroke at a single measured thickness, with open shapes and no calligraphic shading. Encode Sans SC, a sans-serif with a shallow terminal curl and wide gap, is where the pair's quiet strength lies.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-encode-sans-semi-: Drawn as if with a marker tip, Bellota Text is commanding, open, and free of calligraphic shading. Encode Sans Semi Condensed, a sans-serif with an open counter on the s, keeps paragraphs moving easily.
